segmentPatterns.label: Low-Point Setup to Sudden Opportunity
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Cataloging compounding personal and professional failures before an unexpected visitor introduces a radical new premise.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Dark, moody isolated b-roll and kinetic text titles transitioning through a doorway or reveal into bright, high-energy spatial cutouts.

segmentPatterns.label: Trivial Origin to Grand Thesis Transition
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Revealing that a seemingly superficial or vulgar premise actually addresses a profound human or structural problem.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Prurient or casual user mockups contrast against grand CG metaphor (e.g. rocket launch), then relatable everyday pain points.

segmentPatterns.label: Institutional Skepticism Paired with Financial Irony
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: The protagonist pitches to established gatekeepers who scoff, while the narrator reveals the immense value left on the table.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Formal presentation setting followed by giant kinetic rejection quotes, terminating in symbolic burning currency or vortexes of wealth.

segmentPatterns.label: Struggle to Windfall Dynamic Pivot
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Presents early failure and rejection followed by sudden dramatic financial offer or valuation.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Rapid montage of bleak or isolated imagery exploding into high-impact 3D metallic currency typography.

segmentPatterns.label: Competitor Category Color Comparison
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Explains how a product chose visual identity by contrasting against industry leaders.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Shows line-up of established competitor symbols, followed by product asset filling the unaddressed chromatic gap.

segmentPatterns.label: Founder Rift Delineation
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Contrasts work ethic and values of team members leading to schism.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Separates archival photos into opposing visual camps and icons, culminating in visual ouster.

segmentPatterns.label: Rapid Metric Inflection Step
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: States baseline metric then immediately states explosive multi-fold increase.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Displays initial numeric figure, then punches camera in while snapping value to 10x higher figure.

segmentPatterns.label: Challenger vs Incumbent Grid
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Claim that a new entrant functions as the opposite of entrenched category leaders.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Display dominant brand logos clustered together before placing the challenger's unique attribute in sharp contrast.

segmentPatterns.label: Document Scrutiny and Social Fallout
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Describe adverse public narrative or scandal followed by demographic exposure.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Archival document with kinetic highlighter sweep followed by stylized demographic b-roll montage.

segmentPatterns.label: Metric Milestone into Antagonist Hook
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Escalating usage stats resolve into a cliffhanger revealing competitor surveillance.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Massive volume counters over crowd video cut directly to rival corporate headquarters with shadowy silhouette.

segmentPatterns.label: Direct Plagiarism Proofing
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Asserting that a competitor copied features, design, or formatting directly.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Dual mobile UI or interface screenshots arranged side by side with synchronized animated category tags.

segmentPatterns.label: Numbered Explainer Breakdown
segmentPatterns.narrationStructure: Listing distinct structural reasons why an initiative, product, or plan failed.
segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Sequential numbered badges in the corner with symbolic icon pairs on brand-coded backdrops.

segmentPatterns.label: Hostile Move Backfire with Press Receipts

segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Cutout of frustrated competitor transitioning into layered third-party news clippings, concluding with high-value financial symbols.

segmentPatterns.label: Documented Event Confirmation

segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Slow push-in on authentic news headline showing exact event.

segmentPatterns.label: System Paradigm Shift Schematic

segmentPatterns.visualStructure: Iconographic diagram contrasting 1-to-1 connection with 1-to-many broadcast layout.
